name: Ayami Sayataka
source:
A boy known as the worst delinquent in school, constantly causing all sorts of trouble. His father disappeared when he was young, leading him to be raised by a single mother.

[Taken from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/11/10/manimani/]Official Website[/url]]
